items.detail: The **S&P 500** fell **8.6%** to 6,910.39 in its worst week since April 2025, while the Nasdaq dropped about 10% to 22,617.73.
items.why: A deep sell-off in AI stocks, led by chipmakers, wiped out the Nasdaq's gains for 2026.

items.detail: **Nvidia** beat forecasts on Tuesday but then slid all week, ending with a **14%** plunge on Friday to its lowest close in 18 months.
items.why: Jensen Huang's planned exit as CEO and doubts about AI profits outweighed strong results and a big buyback.

items.detail: The S&P 500 and Dow both closed in a **correction**, more than 10% below their records, after seven straight losing days for the S&P.
items.why: Rising bets on a Fed rate hike and Treasury yields near 5% made pricey tech stocks harder to justify.

items.detail: The **MSCI Emerging Markets** index fell into a bear market, more than **20%** below its June high, as Taiwan had its worst week since 1990.
items.why: Asian chipmakers such as Samsung and SK Hynix tracked the US AI sell-off, and EM funds saw heavy outflows.

items.detail: The **Sensex** rose **2.85%** to 83,919.71 and the Nifty gained 2.61% for a fourth straight weekly gain, closing near nine-month highs.
items.why: Banks led as Bank Nifty hit a record, helped by record November foreign buying of Indian shares.

items.detail: The US **Russell 2000** fell about 7% on the week, ending Friday at **2,581.79** after a 2.8% drop that day.
items.why: Small caps could not escape the AI rout, and higher rate-hike bets raise borrowing costs for smaller firms.

items.detail: **Bitcoin** fell below $60,000 and touched **$57,799** on Friday, its lowest in over two years, after losing about 15% on the week.
items.why: The AI stock rout spread into crypto, setting off over $1.5 billion in forced selling of leveraged bets.

items.detail: **Ether** slid to about **$1,740** by Friday, taking its November loss to nearly 23%.
items.why: Steady outflows from spot ether ETFs, close to $1 billion this month, left buyers scarce as risk appetite collapsed.

items.detail: **Solana** dropped below $70 and fell **6.1%** on Friday alone to $68.68.
items.why: Money had been flowing into Solana ETFs but turned to withdrawals as the broader crypto sell-off deepened.

items.detail: Spot **gold** fell **8.7%** to about $3,544 an ounce, its worst week in eight months, after briefly hitting its lowest level since September 2025.
items.why: Growing bets on a Fed hike, surging Treasury yields and a stronger dollar made gold, which pays no interest, less attractive.

crossCuttingTheme: Doubts about AI profits and rising bets on a Fed rate hike, with Treasury yields near 5%, pulled down stocks, crypto and even gold worldwide; India's bank-led rally on foreign buying was the lone exception.
